Soon to be graduate here too. What would be your 1 tip for me when I graduate? $200 a month into my 401k? Pay off my debt first or slowly?

The number one thing you should do, while it's not very fun or glamorous, is save so you have enough to cover 2-3 months of your expenses. It sucks, but when your car has an unexpected repair, you can tap into this emergency fund and pay it off without hassle.

After that, once you get your job after school, on your first day ask about a 401k matching service. Most employers will match 3-6% of your pay into your fund, which is HUGE.

When it comes to debt, you can't make it go away at once. Otherwise no one would have debt. Make a list of your debts and how much you owe. Slowly pay off those you can ASAP, the smaller ones, while making the minimum payments on the others. You will slowly chip away at the larger ones, while you can pay off the smaller ones.
